rival_explanations: A strict newline-only detector: it fires at newline tokens and nowhere else, so the post-copula and post-preposition determiners ('is a', 'in the', 'of the') are predicted inactive and only the blank-line and punctuation-newline classes are real.

A paragraph-start detector that marks where a new text block begins: it should fire on the first word after a blank line or heading ('Body', 'Sunday', 'Welcome') rather than on the bare second newline it actually peaks on.
A general previous-token copy head: it should fire on the token after any frequent function word, including ' on the', ' with the', ' from the' and ' by the', and on the first word of every new line.
